notes: The global careers listing is a server-rendered SuccessFactors/Radancy search at careers.nomura.com/search/. It is a GET form with q (keyword) and three facet selects: optionsFacetsDD_title (Job Title), optionsFacetsDD_facility (Division) and optionsFacetsDD_department (Skill Category). q=engineer reduced the advertised 495 results to 165, confirming the keyword parameter. Pagination is startrow=100 and the sort links use sortColumn/sortDirection. Location is a displayed column and a sort key, not a facet; no location filter parameter is published. The facet select option lists are not server-rendered, so only the department values from collected records are listed.
evidence: https://careers.nomura.com/search/?q=&sortColumn=referencedate&sortDirection=desc (GET form with q, optionsFacetsDD_title, optionsFacetsDD_facility, optionsFacetsDD_department; 495 results)
